name: app-usability-results-cards-with-hatched-bars-and-quote-arc
title: Usability results: three white cards with big thin percentages and hatched bars, plus a quote inside a hairline arc
whatItIs: A near-white slide with a pill label, a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif, three rounded white cards (Money Transfer 92%, Bill Payment 84%, Finding Key Features 89%) each with a thin numeral and a hatched progress bar with a percentage pill, and a large quote mark and testimonial in a huge thin arc.
whatItMeans: Precise and reassuring; thin numerals and hatched bars feel calm and credible.
techniques: Set percentages in a very thin weight.
Frame a quote inside a large hairline arc.
Mix light sans and bold italic serif.

vocabulary.definition: A progress bar filled with diagonal lines.
A card summarising one test outcome.
A huge thin curve as a frame.
A user's words with name and role.
